TABLE.NAME: local_extendednav
TABLE.COMMENT: Navigation nodes added to, or overriding, the primary navigation and the user menu

FIELD.NAME: menu
FIELD.COMMENT: Menu the node belongs to (primary or usermenu)

FIELD.NAME: nodekey
FIELD.COMMENT: Unique key of the node within its menu. Core nodes use their core key

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Display text. Empty on a core node means the core string is used

FIELD.NAME: url
FIELD.COMMENT: Link destination. Empty on a core node means the core URL is used

FIELD.NAME: icon
FIELD.COMMENT: FontAwesome class or Moodle pix icon

FIELD.NAME: visibility
FIELD.COMMENT: 0 = not visible, 1 = visible to everyone, 2 = restricted to roles

FIELD.NAME: roles
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated role shortnames allowed when visibility is restricted

FIELD.NAME: blockaccess
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 to block access to the node URL for users who cannot see the node

FIELD.NAME: langs
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated language codes the node is shown for. Empty means all languages

FIELD.NAME: parentkey
FIELD.COMMENT: Key of the parent node when the node is a submenu item

FIELD.NAME: display
FIELD.COMMENT: How the link opens: 0 = current window, 1 = new window, 2 = pop-up

FIELD.NAME: popupwidth
FIELD.COMMENT: Width of the pop-up window in pixels, when display is 2

FIELD.NAME: popupheight
FIELD.COMMENT: Height of the pop-up window in pixels, when display is 2
